profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft | Project Xcloud

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed and launched an AWS SageMaker endpoint gateway interface using a Docker image of a Flask web application
- Implemented an NER based input and output handling algorithm, and experimented on different Python frameworks to produce a RESTful API for a larger Dynamic Pricing project
- Successfully created a SageMaker endpoint to a model using a TensorFlow Serving container and the AWS BYOC (Bring Your Own Container) template to process accurate predictions

positions.title: Energy Efficiency Extern
positions.description:
- Interviewed lab engineers about the CLEER Model and critiqued the environmental impact of cloud-based software
- Researched and analyzed the structure of Cori, the newest supercomputer
- Audited seminars about data centers and the ways of improving their energy efficiency potentials

positions.title: Computational Biology Workshop Assistant
positions.description:
- Collaborated with six professors to organize and run computing demonstrations
- Test ran learning modules prior to the workshop to check for compatibility and clarity
- Communicated with professors from other liberal arts colleges to improve modules

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
- Created vocabulary quizzes and materials for international students with SAT instructors
- Organized Excel files to keep records of registration and test scores
- Answered reading, writing, and math questions from students
